text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: You seem pretty tired considering you had the day off yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …I was up all night trying to complete a jigsaw puzzle.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I suppose that's what happens when there are a thousand pieces…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But the final picture is supposed to be a beautiful snowy landscape, so I was so determined to finish it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait until it's done.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Silence Suzuka is a bit sleep deprived after spending all night immersed in her jigsaw puzzle.
